generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
THE BIDDERS ARE REQUESTED TO GO THROUGH BID DOCUMENTS

The bidder, as a prime contractor should have Satisfactorily executed Supply, Erection,Testing and Commissioning of HMT Machine Tools Limited/Ace Micromatic / ITL Industries Limited make Double column Semi Automatic Horizontal Metal Cutting Bandsaw Machines of cutting capacity minimum 8 inch or above to any government sector/PSU/Major power plants/Reputed private sector major industries amounting to not less than Rs.11.00 lakhs (including GST) in any one year during the preceding five financial years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25, 2025-26). The bidder should submit relevant Work Orders and corresponding Work done/completion certificates issued by competent authority of the rank not less than Chief engineer or equivalent.Work done of previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited.

The Bidder shall have annual average Turnover of Rs.22.00 lakhs in any two of the preceding five financial years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25, 2025-26). As proof, the bidder shall furnish a copy of Profit & Loss account statement or turnover certificate duly certified by Chartered Accountant. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited.
